info.bio:
Peter Green (nacido como Peter Allen Greenbaum el 29 de octubre de 1946 en Bethnal Green, Londres), es un guitarrista inglés de blues rock y miembro fundador de la banda Fleetwood Mac.

B.B.King se refirió a Green como "el único hombre que me llegó a hacer sudar". Aunque el fraseo de Green no era tan rápido o repentino como el de sus colegas Bluesbrakers Eric Clapton y Mick Taylor, si estaba marcado por un distintivo vibrato y economía de estilo.

scenes.name: Locura psicodélica y space-rock
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El boom psicodélico y el desacondicionamiento hippy alumbran una generación de originales: Syd Barrett y sus dos obras maestras de folk psicodélico (Madcap Laughs, Barrett), Twink y los Pink Fairies, Peter Green (The End Of The Game), Hawkwind, inventores del space-rock entre la cultura hippy y el punk. En EE UU, Bruce Palmer, David Crosby (If I Could Only Remember My Name), Merrell Fankhauser y Mu, Ya Ho Wha 13. En Japón nace el space-rock con Hadaka no Rallizes, la Taj Mahal Travellers («La Monte Young con ácido»), Keiji Haino y Fushitsusha.

scenes.name: Pop de Australia y Nueva Zelanda
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Australia aporta las elegías neorrománticas de los Go-Betweens, las microsinfonías de The Church, Hunters And Collectors, Midnight Oil, Men At Work, Triffids e INXS. Nueva Zelanda cría una generación de antihéroes que no tiene nada que ver con la ola británica comercial y crea el género de los noventa: el «lo-fi pop». The Clean (como si los Buzzcocks versionaran a Syd Barrett y a la Velvet), Tall Dwarfs, Chills, Bats, This Kind Of Punishment, Jean Paul Sartre Experience, Scorched Earth Policy, Able Tasmans, Verlaines y la figura de Peter Jefferies.

podcast.title: Co-Founder of Fleetwood Mac - Named After Rhythm Section
podcast.body: Peter Green co-founded Fleetwood Mac in London with former members of John Mayall's Bluesbreakers. While Green led the group initially, it was notably named after its rhythm section: drummer Mick Fleetwood and bassist John 'Mac' McVie, a paradox that continued throughout the band's existence despite a parade of accomplished lead guitarists. "Fleetwood Mac was one of the biggest, formed in London by former members of John Mayalls Bluesbreakers."

podcast.title: Departure from Fleetwood Mac - Post "Oh Well"
podcast.body: Peter Green departed Fleetwood Mac, the band he co-founded, after the release of "O'Well" in 1970, which had been a number 2 hit in England and cracked the Hot 100 in America. His departure left the band in the hands of other members he had recruited, including Jeremy Spencer and Danny Kirwan. "Long after O'Well, Peter Green departed the band he'd co-founded."
